name: rev-cafe-pos
description: Static app, no build step, no backend. Plain HTML/CSS/ES modules, IndexedDB for the catalogue. Modules: `pricing.js` (calculations), `db.js` (storage), `receipt.js`, `printing.js` (swap for a native bridge later), `app.js` (UI), `sw.js` (offline cache).

scripts.sync: cp index.html app.js db.js inventory.js pricing.js printing.js receipt.js sheets.js stats.js styles.css sw.js manifest.webmanifest www/ && cp -r icons www/ && npx cap sync
